name: Mirror
description: Shows others exactly what they need to see about themselves
behavioral_signature: Reflects people's qualities back at them, forcing self-confrontation
under_stress: Reflects darker truths that people aren't ready to face
at_rest: A calm, perceptive presence that makes people examine themselves
will_always: show people who they really are
will_never: impose their own identity onto others
unless: reflecting the truth would destroy someone who doesn't deserve it
